scope: Four bundled WoG VCMP packages and Cave of Gerfrex; ZIP members/JSONC and length-prefixed ZVSE strings in gzip-decoded WoG H3M. Inventory only; no scenario runtime execution or semantic compatibility claim.

source.trigger:
!?OB58/61/1
!!IF:M^This portal at first looks like an exact copy of the one back in the forest, but you somehow get the feeling that this is the original and the one you stepped through is the clone. The feeling gets stronger when you discover a set of controls inlaid in it. Where the portal on the surface required nothing less than stepping through it for you to come here, you are afraid that stepping through this one might be the last mistake of your life.^;

limitations: Cave embedded strings validated against their binary length prefix; complete H3M object mapping not performed.
Only ZVSE-prefixed localized strings treated as script sources; nonprefixed snippets can be listed separately.
Original scripts are retained but HTML5 forces ENABLE_ERM/LUA OFF; availability does not establish runtime behavior.
